description: Screen a token contract with GoPlus across 8 chains for honeypot, rug-pull and scam signals: can’t-sell traps, hidden mint functions, malicious buy and sell taxes, and holder concentration. The chain defaults to Base (8453). Paid-only, including the first call: this read has no warm cache behind the hosted free allowance. A screen of known risk signals, not a guarantee that a token is safe and not a recommendation. Hosted access: paid-only; each call costs $0.001 USDC through x402 and preserves the free allowance.

address.description: Token contract address (0x followed by 40 hex characters).

chain.description: Chain id or name, case-insensitive: 1 (ethereum, eth), 10 (optimism), 56 (bsc, bnb), 137 (polygon, matic), 196 (xlayer), 8453 (base), 42161 (arbitrum), 43114 (avalanche, avax). Default: 8453 (Base).

x_payment.description: Signed x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive the machine-actionable payment challenge, then retry with the signed payload.
